episodes.title: Dong-ju, Betrayed by Love
episodes.summary: Seo Dong Ju is confident he can have it all, Daesan Group and the love of his life. But...

episodes.title: Dong-ju, Taken Out by Attackers after Securing Slush Funds
episodes.summary: Dong Ju risks being kicked out of Daesan Group after news spreads about him living with Eun Nam.

episodes.title: Dong-ju, Steals 2 Trillion Won to Stay Alive
episodes.summary: Dong Ju deceives Yeom Jang Seon and steals 2 trillion won to survive.

episodes.title: Dong-ju, Returns to Recover Lost Memories
episodes.summary: Yeom Jang Seon searches for Dong Ju belatedly. Dong Ju wakes up remembering only the name Seong Hyeon.

episodes.title: Dong Ju's Mind Holds Two Trillion Won
episodes.summary: Dong Ju returns, but Yeom Jang Seon refuses to believe his amnesia.

episodes.title: Resurfacing Memories, and Sister Agnes
episodes.summary: No matter the torture, Dong Ju claims to remember nothing. Heo Il Do suggests hypnosis therapy.

episodes.title: Cinnamon from the One behind Sister Agnes' Death
episodes.summary: During Sister Agnes' funeral, Dong Ju sets out to find those responsible for his sister's death.

episodes.title: Forget the Two Trillion and Kill Seo Dong Ju
episodes.summary: Dong Ju falls into a coma, and Yeom Jang Seon seizes the chance to take over Daesan Group.

episodes.title: Here's the Gun, Sir
episodes.summary: Dong Ju must save Eun Nam from Jang Seon's murder plot. He uncovers the force backing Jang Seon.

episodes.title: I'd Like to Meet You Just Once
episodes.summary: While searching for the Dandelion files to complete his revenge, Dong Ju uncovers a shocking truth.

episodes.title: Keep It a Secret Until the End
episodes.summary: After learning about his father, Dong Ju investigates his car accident from 30 years ago.

episodes.title: I'm Still Alive, Keep Shooting
episodes.summary: Dong Ju secures the Dandelion files, including the truth about the incident from 30 years ago.

episodes.title: You're a Terrible Person, a Real Bastard
episodes.summary: After Il Do learns the truth about his son, he cuts off Jang Seon. Jang Seon seeks out Gang Cheon.

episodes.title: Mr. Yeom Crawling at My Feet, Begging?
episodes.summary: Saved by Il Do's sacrifice, Dong Ju begins planning his revenge against Jang Seon.

episodes.title: I'm Not Even Allowed to Say That?
episodes.summary: Having lost everything, Jang-seon vows to claim Daesan Group, fuelling a rivalry with Dong-ju.

episodes.title: You'll Have to Ask More Earnestly
episodes.summary: With his revenge complete, Dong-ju ties up loose ends. But where's Jang-seon?
